To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ets GGAA motif is duplicated, overlapped or clustered within a distance of 500-bp upstream of the transcription start site of the cDNA in several human genes that are responsive to the tumor promoter 12-O-tetradeconoylphorbol-13-aceate (TPA).
the duplicated ets (or GGAA) motifs located at the 5′-proximal region of the TSS of TATA-less human genes play an important role in recruiting the transcriptional apparatus to the promoter region.
duplication or multiplication of the ets motif near transcription start site (5′-flank) is a possible mechanism for the regulation of gene expression in human cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possible function(s) of the duplicated ets ( GGAA) motifs in the 5′-regulatory region of human genes.
the possible functions of the duplicated ets motifs near TSSs of various genes.
the molecular mechanisms that control the initiation of transcription in the nucleus.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of the duplicated ets ( GGAA) motifs located in the 500 bp upstream of the TSS of the human gene is one of the molecular characteristics for the TATA-less promoters.

the duplicated ets (GGA) motifs located in the vicinity of the TSS of TATA-less human genes are important for the initiation of the transcription and for the recruitment and binding of transcriptional regulatory proteins to the TSS.
the duplication and multiplication of GGAA motifs located within 500 bp from the TSS of TATA-less promoter are important in transcriptional activation of several human genes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the duplicated ets motifs near the TSS of TATA-less promoter are involved in the recruitment of the transcription initiation complex, and thus, are responsible for transcriptional activation of the genes.
the duplication of ets (GGAAGGA) motifs located near the TSS of TATA-less genes is a novel regulatory mechanism that is responsible for initiation of transcription.
the duplicated ets motifs are involved in transcriptional regulation of various human genes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the duplicated ets motifs located near the TSS may play an important role in transcription regulation of TPA-responsive genes.
the duplication of the ets motif is an important factor for the initiation of TATA-less transcription.
the presence of duplicated ets motifs near TSSs of various genes may be one of the mechanisms for the initiation of gene transcription.
